title: THE RAIDER HELMET AND BANDOLIER ARE CHIPPED
why: Art build step b, the rest of the Raider set (his pick: Refined Chibi with Gear-heavy raider). The Tactical Helmet gets a scheme colour panel stripe across the dome and four bare steel paint chips, and the Bandolier strap gets four steel flecks between its cartridges. Everything stays inside the old outline, so no anchor moves.
now: The Raider helmet and bandolier now show chipped paint and a colour stripe.
